'''Naorisa Cambral''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].

== Strength and Abilities ==
Nothing is known about Naorisa's strength or abilities in the One Power. {{ref|{{twotc}}, Naorisa Cambral}}

== Activities ==
She is elected as a [[Sitter]] in the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower|Rebel Hall]] to replace [[Delana Mosalaine]].{{Ref/book|12|43}} She reswears the [[Three Oaths]] on the [[Oath Rod]] and proves that she is not [[Black Ajah]].{{Ref/book|12|43}} She is then part of the unanimous vote to attack the [[White Tower]] with their army.{{Ref/book|12|43}}

After the reunification, she and [[Kwamesa Taramasu]] (the other Gray Sitter elected in the Rebel Hall) were no longer Sitters. [[Varilin Zanaire]] and [[Yukiri Haruna]] resumed the seats they had before the split with the seat formerly held by the Darkfriend sister [[Evanellein Lorn]], being taken by [[Andaya Forae]] who was appointed by the [[Head Clerk]] of the Gray Ajah, [[Serancha Colvine]].{{ref/book|13|27}}
